e7_s4_rationale: The patient's histopathological examination demonstrated spindle cells with branching ectatic vasculature and up to 20 mitoses per ten high-power fields, and immunohistochemical studies showed strong immunoreactivity for CD31, CD99, and Fli-1, which are characteristic features of Hemangiopericytoma

e7_s4_rejected.label: Solitary fibrous tumor
e7_s4_rejected.why: Lack of strong immunoreactivity for CD34 and Bcl-2, which are typical for Solitary fibrous tumor

e7_s4_rejected.label: Meningioma
e7_s4_rejected.why: Intraoperative findings of mass invading falx cerebri and adjacent cortex, and histopathological examination showing high mitotic activity, are not typical for Meningioma

e7_s4_rejected.label: Cavernous angioma
e7_s4_rejected.why: Histopathological examination did not show the characteristic multinodular architecture and hyalinized vessels of Cavernous angioma

e7_s4_rejected.label: Angiosarcoma
e7_s4_rejected.why: Although the tumor showed high mitotic activity, the immunohistochemical profile and histopathological features are more consistent with Hemangiopericytoma than Angiosarcoma
